scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer for 2–5 players, full exact candidate material claims and important omissions.
scope.method: Read the full frozen candidate and compare throughout against the complete authoritative rulebook already read in this source-only review; re-read PDF text for pp. 10, 14, 18, 22, 23, 25, 28, 29 for changed clauses and interactions. Source production, mat/recruit, all six structure and scoring diagrams have been visually inspected. No other reports or benchmark materials read; candidate and prior audits not edited.

checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Each controlled non-Factory territory including lakes counts once; Factory counts three total rather than one plus three; home bases excluded. Sum counts before multiplying by popularity territory rate. Resource pairs rounded down and separately scored. New table/general formula supported and internally consistent.

Upfront effect description correctly identifies improving top benefit and reducing bottom cost; subsequent instructions still pay exposed oil cost before cube movement. Any green cube to empty bracketed red box, no solid-border red box. Description does not authorize gaining benefit before payment.

Secret simultaneous commitment, simultaneous reveal and total, attacker wins ties; then BOTH players deduct dial power and discard EVERY used card face-up, no track deduction for card values. Separate numbered steps accurately express source; winner/loser costs and loser compensation retained.
Greatest fortune, clockwise individual turns with no rounds, sixth-star immediate end, required faction component counts and plastic versus wooden combat distinction.

Deck shuffles, players+1 Factory cards and unseen remainder, random structure tile, eleven encounters, supply, random mats, seating, correct starting tracks/cards/coins, two objectives, all starting piece locations, empty one-time spaces, lowest Player Mat begins.
Public combat card count/secret contents, secret objectives, coins not hidden but total need not be revealed, concealed card commitment until reveal.

Different section except Rusviet, optional top then optional bottom, once each, either/both/neither, full current exposed cost before optional benefits, top pays bottom, dead turns and noninteractive turn overlap.

Home bases never territories and normal entry/build/deploy restrictions, retreat/setup/Wayfare exceptions; control by unit or own structure without enemy unit, enemy worker controls occupied building/resources, owner keeps abilities except uncontrolled Mill; defender temporary control. Four resources only, spend any controlled supply to act anywhere, return spent tokens, unlimited supply/stacking.

Two different units one step or one coin before upgrades, sequential movement; all units carry resources, only mechs workers; carried workers retain own move. Rivers/lakes restricted by default, shoreline rule, all printed tunnels adjacent, personal Mine enemy-control exception. Speed plastic only, extra step and mid-move load/unload.

Enemy structure-only entry permitted, worker independent hostile-entry restrictions; workers-only forced retreat immediate without combat, one popularity each even insufficient. Plastic enemy entry stops unit, all movement then attacker-ordered combats then encounters before bottom; encounter character stops all turn and lost battle leaves token.

One coin for two power or card, reshuffle/exhaustion; one coin for any two resources or popularity, same controlled worker territory for resources, cannot resource-Trade when all workers home; Monument popularity and Armory power correctly applied.

Full pre-production exposed cost, up to two controlled distinct territories before upgrades, per-worker terrain outputs on producing territory, left-to-right optional new workers after payment and future costs only, no returns to mat; lake/Factory none; controlled Mill adds territory and worker-equivalent output alongside actual workers and can work without one.

Correct oil/metal/wood/food mapping, exposed mat quantity, coins optional, completed paid actions still trigger coins/recruits, announce action; normal deployment/build on controlled worker territory not lakes/home bases, ability all plastic not workers; one structure total per territory, Factory allowed, permanent structures and four effects correct.

Any recruit to any empty one-time bonus, permanent two power/coins/popularity/cards. Ongoing original section maps Upgrade power/Deploy coin/Build popularity/Enlist card one each; self and immediate neighbors matching bottom only; active-left-right order, two-player once, Factory/top/encounter exclusions, sixth-star cutoff.

Rusviet repeat incl Factory; Crimea once per turn one card as one resource irrespective of value; Nordic workers river-cross not lakes; Polania two different encounter choices from one card any order with first funding second; Saxony retains second objective and uncapped available objective/combat stars.
Rusviet farm/village; Crimea farm/tundra; Nordic and Saxony forest/mountain; Polania village/mountain, plastic units only; all factions unlock Speed.

Underpass controlled mountains/tunnels/Mine, Disarm two opponent track power before tunnel/Mine battle once per combat; Township controlled villages/Factory; Peoples Army one extra card total with worker and plastic unit, correct two-mech/three-worker example.

Seaworthy lake movement and adjacent-lake retreat with carried workers, Artillery one power for opponent loss two once per combat; Wayfare own/inactive incl expansion bases not active enemies, Scout one random stolen card once per combat.

Submerge lake movement and lake-to-lake, Camaraderie only after aggressive combat victory not undefended workers; no abandoned workers/resources in lakes, workers need mechs to leave; no building/deployment, lake battle possible, Polania lacks Nordic retreat exception.

Zero power/popularity permitted, attacker ability first, dial zero through min(7,current), optional card per plastic and Rusviet bonus even zero dial, ties attacker, both pay, winner control/star and ordinary two-star cap versus Saxony, all loser units retreat leaving resources with Nordic exception, attacker worker-popularity loss including lake workers, defender none, loser one card if positive power revealed, pending attacks undone at game end.

Character-only encounter after full move/combats, show card/art and thematic capitals aloud, required affordable option except Polania, optional benefits/full cost, all gained units/structures/resources to encounter, no normal costs/mat/recruit benefits, face-down under deck. Each character first Factory finish must select one permanent card, no swap; fifth section top then bottom with normal repeat, no corresponding mat benefits, bottom one unit two steps or three with Speed and ordinary stops/Mine.

Own-turn objective reveal before/after top/bottom only with full requirements then; may defer, normal one star and both cards bottom-deck, Saxony retains other; informal agreements unenforceable, only tangible coins, tournament deal prohibition, cannot cancel initiated combat.

All nine trigger types and quantities, ordinary once except two combat and Saxony, permanent/unblocked stars; sixth immediate, no equalizing turns; bottom primary/coins/own recruit benefit before ending star, active-left-right neighbors and cutoff, undo unresolved mixed movement.

Held coins plus popularity bracket 0–6 rates 3/2/1, 7–12 rates 4/3/2, 13–18 rates 5/4/3 for stars/territories/resource pairs, pairs pooled and odd discarded, workers/cards excluded as resources; tie order workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources, territories, stars.

checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Adjacent printed tunnels 1/2–3/4–5/6 = 2/4/6/9; lakes/encounters 1/2–3/4–5/6–7 = 2/4/6/9; on printed tunnels 1/2/3–4 = 2/4/6; longest straight row and combined farm/tundra 1/2/3/4 = 2/4/6/9. Unique adjacent feature once, Mine exclusion, removed encounters count, rivers do not break adjacency/row, enemy control no loss of bonus, zero features zero.

important_omission_review: No important in-scope omission found after checking setup, costs/benefits, destinations, movement permissions and stops, every faction, encounters, Factory, recruit/end timing, six structure tiles, scoring and tiebreaks. Mat-dependent values are correctly delegated to the exposed physical mat. Full global inventory, combat-card frequencies, strategy and teaching notes are acceptable summary omissions.
conclusion: PASS for recorded candidate hash. Factory three-territory formula, upfront Upgrade effect description and separate combat reveal/payment steps are source-supported and preserve the relevant interactions.
